purpose: One fixed before/after validation requested by the user; no parameter selection from these outcomes
cohort: All 528 eligible paired questions from the same archived frozen retrieval cohorts

shared.grading: normalized exact match and token F1

comparison: Paired per-question outcomes before vs after, reported separately for each retrieval condition. This compares the bundled reader changes; it does not attribute individual effects.
dmr_boundary: Same archived rankings for reader-only QA comparison; repaired DMR retrieval and corrected evidence recall are not measured here.

runtime_allocation_adjustment.reason: Reduce unused KV reservation under GPU contention; no changes to model, prompt, decoding, question selection, or scoring. No protocol selection based on scores.
